name: codex-deepseek-subagent
description: Delegate bounded read-heavy work from an OpenAI Codex parent to a DeepSeek child without changing the parent provider.

interface.longDescription: Keeps the OpenAI parent in control while a dedicated DeepSeek child handles bounded, read-heavy text work through Codex native subagent lifecycle. The bridge writes short-lived local handoff state, and the setup Skill can install or remove one managed personal Agent file.
defaultPrompt: $use-deepseek-subagent Analyze this bounded log set without modifying files.
$setup-deepseek-subagent Inspect and install the managed DeepSeek worker.
